releaseNotes: Adds ten more distinct, verse-specific faith-response records, each with its own prayer, declaration, affirmation, confession and context-aware inspiration. New passages address God's help on the journey, grief, weariness, daily trust, servant leadership, Christ's peace, renewed thinking, patient love, prayer and perseverance. The coverage gate now requires 160 unique visible references and validates all five response fields against the offline KJV. Refreshes offline cache.
